about: The D23 text judge (T1188): the threshold rule and the backends. A judge's verdicts count only when its calibration against human labels passes every rule under `threshold`; otherwise the runner keeps them out of the gate (the text layer's `supported` share is None, so the check warns). Research and reasons: Execution/P15/T1188-llm-judge.md.

gemini.note: A Pro tier judges the Flash-written texts (less self-preference); flash-latest is the fallback and the result names the model that ran. Gemini 3 guidance keeps temperature at 1.0; votes > 1 takes the majority verdict.
